Content: This is by far the best juicer I’ve ever had.  I’ve have many juicers, both slow masticating and centrifugal juicers.  The masticating are great if you have the time or patience to wait for the juice.

I can’t stop raving about it.  You don’t have to chop any fruits or veggies, just wash.  There is no pulp just smooth juice.  It takes less than a minute to juice enough for a half a pitcher.  Maybe more but I haven’t tried.  It’s super easy to disassemble and wash.  It is heavy duty and large. I know it will last and is a good investment for my health.
This isn’t a paid advertisement but I’d do a commercial for Breville if I could.

Staying at a hotel in Germany I enjoyed fresh pressed vegetable juice. Upon arrival back in the US I searched for a high quality cold press juicer. I am very pleased with this stainless steel machine. Clean up is easy the - fruit and vegetable juices are fantastic. Highly recommended!
This is the best juicer I’ve owned. It has great performance, extraction is superior. Easy to use and clean up was fast .

Handles all types of fruits and veggies without a problem. Produces great volumes of juice, and is much easier to clean up than prior brands I've had. The scrub brush included is a great bonus. Speed knob helps with produce thats more bulky, but I haven't had a reason to use it passed 50% yet. It tears through everything without a problem. Noise level is not bad, and the material left in the catch bucket is pretty dry compared to other brands. So far I'm happy with this purchase.

This is our first juicer and wanted it to last us a while, we had a great deal on it when amazon presented the price so I had to snag it.  The Juicer is great overall and very fast to create juice when doing watermelon, apples, carrots etc... Although the spin is fast, it does creates foam when it hits the jug, so you would have to let it settle, unless you like the foam.  Overall, very satisfied with the machine and have been using it regularly, clean it is great, very well made and heavy so it doesnt vibrate off your table.  Recommend to purchase if you're in a market for one.
